mcpLanding.card2Text: Same JSON config block for both MCP clients.
mcpLanding.card3Text: Lookups plus ranked forward-looking accounts for research agents.
mcpLanding.configBlurb: Add to Cursor MCP settings or Claude Desktop claude_desktop_config.json, then restart.
mcpLanding.faq1Q: Is this the same as other “xflux” MCP packages?
mcpLanding.faq1A: No. @xflux/xflux-mcp-server is for the XFlux X/Twitter API at xfluxapi.com. Unrelated Figma or design MCPs that share the name are different products.
mcpLanding.faq2Q: What can agents do with MCP?
mcpLanding.faq2A: Read profiles, search tweets, pull timelines, look up tweets, list monitors/hits (read-only), and discover Smart Money accounts. Create monitors and webhooks in the Dashboard.
mcpLanding.faq3Q: Does MCP use my API quota?
mcpLanding.faq3A: Yes — each tool call counts like a REST request against your plan quota.
mcpLanding.ctaBottomDesc: Free tier includes 1,000 API calls/month. Full tool reference lives in the docs.

discordLanding.faq1A: No. Use Make.com’s Discord modules with a Custom Webhook, or point XFlux signed webhooks at your own Discord bot.
discordLanding.faq2Q: Which plan do I need for live Discord alerts?

discordLanding.faq3A: HMAC-SHA256 over {timestamp}.{raw_body} using the Dashboard signing secret. See /docs/webhooks.
